lines.hello: Oh, there you are! Come in, come in. I hope the trip wasn't too long.
lines.welcome: Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
lines.myName: My name is Juniper. I spend my days asking where Pokémon first came from, and I never run out of questions.
lines.world: Pokémon live everywhere you look: in the grass by the road, in rivers and caves, on mountains and over the sea.
lines.oneOfThem: This little one is always tidying up after everyone. Say hello!
lines.liveAlongside: People and Pokémon get by together here. They work side by side, they play, and some of them battle as partners.
lines.study: My research is about their beginnings: how each kind of Pokémon came to be what it is today.
lines.enough: But that's enough about my work. I'd like to hear about you.
lines.boyOrGirl: Are you a boy, or are you a girl?
lines.nextDoor: There's a boy in your town who's about your age. He's set on becoming a strong Trainer.
lines.neverStill: He trains every single day, and he never stays put for long.
lines.ofCourse: I'm sure you two will push each other to do your best.
lines.story: {name}, your journey through Unova starts in Aspertia City, high on the hill at the south-west of the region.
lines.offYouGo: Off you go! Unova is waiting for you!
